submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit shots, I tested two regions: Bi-V-rich near the BiVO4 line (121) and Bi-poor, V-rich near the Cu:V ≈ 1:2 (CuV2O6-like) ratio (54). The V-rich region gave ~45x higher photocurrent. The last shot went to a nearby composition with slightly less Bi and Cu:V ≈ 0.5 (148), which gave the highest photocurrent: 3.15e-5 A.

rejected.reason: Measured 6.3e-7 A, far lower. The BiVO4-like region with ~24% Cu performs poorly.
